verdict.rationale: Flagright is a REST API SaaS product, so scoped API credentials are a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no API key scoping, roles, or least-privilege credential issuance. The only credential-related item is rolling webhook signing secrets, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
